note: ClearPotential (arXiv:2512.09989) ensemble-mean gravitational potential: six equipotential surfaces, every other level of the paper's Figure 1 set without its shallowest, inside the 3.8 kpc analysis sphere around the Sun. Surfaces from skimage marching_cubes on a 320^3 grid (generate_plts.py), clipped and triangulated in Blender (mesh_clipper_exp.py), then vertex-clustered on a 0.12 kpc lattice for the web and quantized to 1 pc. Coordinates: Sun-centred Galactocentric kpc * 1000 as int16 (x toward the anti-centre, y along Galactic rotation, z up); faces as uint16 triangle indices, wound so normals point away from the Galactic-centre axis.
units: Phi in 1e5 (km/s)^2; positions in pc relative to the Sun (Galactocentric x = 8.122 kpc, z = 0.0208 kpc)
